topic: Excluding zero dwell time sessions from analytics
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the calculation of dwell time. It was confirmed that zero-duration sessions are excluded when calculating dwell time in 'molah' (a specific system/area). Furthermore, it was noted that on the main dashboard and in production analytics, these zero-duration sessions are already excluded after traffic fixation.
decisions: Zero-duration sessions are excluded from dwell time calculations in 'molah'.
Zero-duration sessions are excluded from the main dashboard and production analytics.
